knowledge_policy.rule: No prior validated research, model result, experiment, error, or recovered artifact is discarded merely because the architecture changes.
knowledge_policy.promotion_rule: Historical knowledge is retained with provenance and may be reused only after compatibility and validation checks.
knowledge_policy.failure_rule: Known failure modes become regression tests or explicit research constraints whenever technically applicable.
knowledge_policy.model_rule: A new model does not overwrite an older model; versions remain recoverable and comparable.
knowledge_policy.data_rule: Dataset and feature lineage must identify source, period, market, timeframe, preprocessing and feature version.
knowledge_policy.execution_rule: Paper/live execution results are recorded as observations and never silently become training data.
